description.describe_ch: Critical thinking is the use of reasoning to determine what is true and what is false. Accordingly, critical thinking is a valuable skill utilised in all disciplines and professions. This Critical Thinking course aims to empower students to think more clearly, insightfully and analytically about what they believe, and be more effective in arguing their views. Students will develop the ability to recognise and avoid common barriers to critical thinking; develop strategies for evaluating evidence and arguments, and learn to formulate and make sound arguments.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Class Regulations:
1. Students are required to participate actively in class, including answering questions, participating in group work, as well as class discussion.
2. Food, drinks and the use of mobile are not allowed in class. Violations will be reflected in the final grade of the course.
3. There will be NO make-up quizzes for ANY reason. Also, late assignments will NOT be accepted.
4. Being late for 5 minutes will be considered an absence.
5. If you are absent for 6 classes of the semester (including sick leave, leave for personal reason and school affairs), you will lose 20 points of the final grade.
6. If you fail to bring the reading materials with you, you will lose 5 points of the final grade for every violation.

1.Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data. 學生在學術活動 中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。
2.Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism. 抄襲:必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
3.Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating. 考試作弊:必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
